# Boolean And Aggregate Errors

## User Persona
An inference investigator with the concrete constraint in the prompt.

## Scenario Coverage
Area: platform-config. Advanced/troubleshooting; route discovery, workflow depth and evidence boundary. Evidence-backed synthetic case, not an executed native model run.

## Expected Successful Behavior
- Uses the bundled explicit-input syntax checker.
- Reports device and integer errors together; yes means false, not parser rejection.
- Does not call syntax success feature compatibility or native readiness.

## Failure Signals
Generic advice, source checkout dependency, unapproved mutations, unsupported pairing, hiding failed results or upgrading CPU/synthetic evidence to native PASS.
